id.description: The stable identifier for the property expense record.

propertyId.description: The identifier of the Property record this expense belongs to.

ownerEname.description: The W3DS eName of the person or group that owns this expense record.

category.description: The operational category of the expense, such as maintenance, utilities, or insurance.

description.description: A concise explanation of the property expense.

supplier.description: The supplier or payee associated with the expense when known.

amountMinor.description: The expense amount in the smallest unit of its currency.

currencyCode.description: The ISO 4217 currency code for the expense amount.

recordKind.description: Whether the record is a plan, an actual expense, or a forecast.

status.description: The operating status of the expense record.

entryDate.description: The local business date the expense is recorded against.

createdAt.description: When the expense record was created.

updatedAt.description: When the expense record was last changed.
